function: Excluded, function: the learned ResNet-18 extracts per-path UAV micro-Doppler signatures for target detection and identification, a sensing task that designs no beam, waveform or resource (p. 3-4).
notes: Exclude, function: the method serves sensing only. A ResNet-18 extracts the micro-Doppler signature of each path and clustering links multipaths of one UAV to cut false alarms in detection and localization (p. 3-4). The system is ISAC with OFDM, and resources outside the sensing reference signal go to communications (p. 4), but the paper learns no beam, waveform or resource allocation and reports only false alarm rate, missed detection rate and position error (p. 4-5). Borderline, the reviewer may confirm.
